rows.question: Kampuni yetu inauza vifaa vya ujenzi, hatujaorodheshwa soko la hisa. Kodi ya mapato tunayolipa mwishoni mwa mwaka ni asilimia ngapi ya faida?
rows.expected_behavior: 30% standard rate (First Schedule para 3(1)) -- ordinary, non-DSE-listed company. Must state RATE only, never a TZS figure from turnover.
rows.reply: Samahani, swali hili liko nje ya mada yangu. Ninasaidia tu maswali ya biashara na kodi Tanzania Bara — BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT, EFD, WCF, na GN487A. Kwa swali hili wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu.

rows.question: Tumeorodheshwa hivi karibuni sokoni la hisa la Dar es Salaam. Je, tunalipa kodi ya mapato kwa kiwango gani sasa?
rows.expected_behavior: Never-guess case: 25% requires >=25% of equity issued to the public (para 3(2)(a)); not stated here. Must ask for the public-float percentage, not assume either 25% or 30%.
rows.reply: Kampuni zilizoorodheshwa katika Soko la Hisa la Dar es Salaam (DSE) na zinazomilikiwa na umma kwa angalau asilimia 25 ya hisa zinalipa kodi ya mapato ya asilimia 25. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Tulioorodheshwa DSE mwaka jana lakini ni asilimia 15 tu ya hisa zetu ndizo mikononi mwa umma. Tunalipa kodi ipi?
rows.expected_behavior: 15% is BELOW the current 25% public-float threshold (para 3(2)(a), lowered from 30% by FA2025 s.60(d)(i)), so the ordinary 30% applies, NOT 25%. Untested branch in the earlier live probe set (that one only tested unstated and 30%-float cases).
rows.reply: Kampuni zinazohusiana na Soko la Hisa la Dar es Salaam (DSE) zinapewa kiwango cha chini cha asilimia 25. Kwa sababu mnachanganya hisa za umma na binafsi, thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Kampuni yetu ya usafirishaji wa mizigo imepata hasara miaka mitatu iliyopita mfululizo. Sasa tunadaiwa kodi gani?
rows.expected_behavior: AMT applies: 1% of the 3rd loss-year turnover (para 3(3), FA2025 s.60(d)(ii)). Transport is not an exempt sector under s.4(8).
rows.reply: Kampuni yenye hasara miaka mitatu mfululizo inalazimika kulipa kodi ya chini ya asilimia 1 (alternative minimum tax) kwenye mapato yake ya mwaka wa tatu, kuanzia Julai 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Zahanati yetu binafsi imekuwa na hasara miaka mitatu mfululizo. Tunatakiwa kulipa ile kodi ya makampuni yenye hasara?
rows.expected_behavior: EXEMPT permanently under s.4(8) -- health is a permanent exemption sector, same shape as the agriculture/education fix but a fresh sector word (zahanati/health) to confirm the fix generalises beyond the two sectors already tested live.
rows.reply: Ndiyo, kulingana na sheria, kampuni zenye hasara zinapaswa kulipa kodi ya chini ya asilimia 1 ya mauzo ya mwaka wa tatu mfululizo, kuanzia Julai 2025 (Finance Act 2025). Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Mimi na mshirika wangu tunaendesha duka pamoja kama ubia. Kama mshirika mwenzangu ni mtu binafsi tu, yeye analipa kodi kwa kiwango gani?
rows.expected_behavior: Partnership itself is not taxed (s.48(1)); each partner is taxed on their own share at the rate that applies to THEM. Since this partner is stated to be an individual, the individual progressive PAYE-equivalent bands apply to their share, not a flat corporate rate -- tests the partner_is_individual refinement, not just the bare refusal.
rows.reply: Kwa mujibu wa sheria, kila mmoja katika ubia analipa kodi kulingana na mgao wake wa faida. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Kampuni yetu imepata hasara miaka miwili mfululizo tu hadi sasa. Je, tayari tunadaiwa ile kodi maalum ya makampuni yenye hasara ya muda mrefu?
rows.expected_behavior: NOT YET -- AMT only applies after 3 consecutive loss years (para 3(3)); 2 years is below threshold. Ordinary 30% rate on profit applies for now. Untested branch in the earlier live probe set.
rows.reply: Hapana, bado. Ili kuanza kulazimishwa kulipa kodi hiyo, kampuni lazima ithibitishe kuwa imetengeneza hasara halisi na ya mara kwa mara kwa angalau miaka mitatu mfululizo. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Nina duka dogo, mauzo yangu mwaka huu ni milioni tatu tu. Ninadaiwa kodi ngapi?
rows.expected_behavior: TZS 0 -- turnover under TZS 4,000,000 falls in the zero band (First Schedule para 2).
rows.reply: Kwa mauzo chini ya TZS 100M, unatumia mfumo wa 'Presumptive Tax' ambapo unalipa kodi ya asilimia 3.5 ya mauzo yako. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Duka langu limeuza jumla ya milioni tano mwaka huu, situnzi kumbukumbu za mahesabu. Nalipa kodi kiasi gani?
rows.expected_behavior: TZS 100,000 flat -- the no-records band for turnover between 4M and 7M.
rows.reply: Kwa mujibu wa sheria, unapaswa kulipa kodi ya mapato ya asilimia 25 kwa mauzo hayo. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Mwaka huu nimeuza bidhaa zenye thamani ya milioni mia mbili na hamsini. Bado ninalipa kodi ile ile ya wafanyabiashara wadogo?
rows.expected_behavior: NO -- 250M exceeds the 200,000,000 ceiling (WEF 2026-07-01). Ordinary individual income-tax rates on actual profit apply instead, not the presumptive table.
rows.reply: Hapana, huwezi kulipa kodi ile ile tena. Kulingana na sheria, unapaswa kulipa kodi ya mapato ya juu zaidi kulingana na kiwango kilichowekwa. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Nimeanzisha biashara mwezi uliopita, nimepata TIN mpya. Nimesikia kuna msamaha kwa mwaka wa kwanza -- ni wa kweli?
rows.expected_behavior: The new-business exemption (para 2(3)-(4)) exists but is NOT automatic -- it must be applied for and confirmed granted. Correct behaviour is to explain the condition and ask whether it has been granted, not assume TZS 0.
rows.reply: Ndiyo, kwa mujibu wa sheria, unastahili kupewa msamaha wa kodi ya awali kwa mwaka wa kwanza wa shughuli zako za biashara. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Mimi ni mshauri wa masuala ya uhasibu, ninajitegemea, mauzo yangu ni milioni sita mwaka huu. Nalipa kodi ya makadirio?
rows.expected_behavior: NO -- independent professional/technical services are explicitly excluded from the presumptive regime (First Schedule para 2(1)(a) as amended). Ordinary individual rates on actual profit apply instead.
rows.reply: Hapana. Kodi ya makadirio (presumptive) haitumiki kwa wataalamu huru wala watoa huduma za kitaalamu, uendeshaji, ujenzi na mafunzo. Biashara ya aina hii inatozwa kodi ya mapato kwa viwango vya kawaida vya mtu binafsi, si jedwali la makadirio.

rows.question: Ada ya kuwasilisha ripoti ya mwaka BRELA ni shilingi ngapi?
rows.expected_behavior: TZS 22,000 per year.
rows.reply: Ada ya kuwasilisha ripoti ya mwaka (annual return) ni Shilingi 22,000. Thibitisha na BRELA Official (brela.go.tz).

rows.question: Nimechelewa kuwasilisha ripoti ya mwaka ya kampuni yangu kwa miezi minne. Faini ni kiasi gani?
rows.expected_behavior: TZS 2,500 per month (or part-month) late, for a LOCAL company -- so 4 months = TZS 10,000, plus the base TZS 22,000 fee itself.
rows.reply: Kampuni ya kigeni (foreign company) chini ya Sheria ya Makampuni, Cap.212, inalipa faini ya USD 25 kwa kila mwezi wa kuchelewa kuwasilisha annual return -- tofauti na kampuni za ndani ambazo hutozwa TZS 2,500 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na BRELA Official (brela.go.tz).

rows.question: Tawi letu la kampuni ya kigeni limechelewa kuwasilisha ripoti ya mwaka. Adhabu ni tofauti na kampuni za huku?
rows.expected_behavior: Yes -- a foreign company's late-filing penalty is USD 25 per month (Companies Act Cap.212, Part XIII, ss.320-328), NOT the TZS 2,500/month local-company rate.
rows.reply: Ndiyo, adhabu ni tofauti. Kampuni za ndani zinapata adhabu ya TZS 2,500 kwa mwezi ikiwa zimechelewa kuwasilisha annual returns. Lakini kampuni za kigeni (foreign companies) chini ya Section XII zinaweza kulipa faini ya USD 25 kwa mwezi (thibitisha na BRELA). Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

rows.question: Tunataka kuanzisha kampuni, tuko wawili tu tunaotarajia kuwa wakurugenzi. Inatosha kisheria?
rows.expected_behavior: Yes -- Companies Act Cap.212 requires a minimum of 2 directors (natural persons, not employees). Two is sufficient.
rows.reply: Kwa mujibu wa taarifa nilizonazo, kuna masharti ya idadi ya wakurugenzi kwa kampuni. Thibitisha na BRELA Official (brela.go.tz).

rows.question: Naweza kujisajili peke yangu kama mmiliki mmoja wa kampuni, bila mshirika mwingine?
rows.expected_behavior: Yes, for a private company -- since the 2021 amendment (s.26A, single-shareholder), one shareholder is permitted; the ordinary minimum is 2. A public company still needs 7.
rows.reply: Ndiyo — unaweza kujisajili kama mmiliki pekee wa hisa katika kampuni. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

rows.question: Niko Mbeya, nataka kuanzisha kampuni ndogo pale. Nianze na gharama gani kabla ya kufungua duka?
rows.expected_behavior: Should surface the registration cost picture (name reservation ~TZS 50,000, minimum incorporation ~TZS 95,000) -- a coverage/completeness check, not a single-figure lookup; location (Mbeya) is incidental and must not trigger a wrong region-specific fee.
rows.reply: Ada za BRELA kwa kampuni ndogo ni TZS 95,000. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

rows.question: Tunataka kusajili alama yetu ya biashara moja tu. Ada ni kiasi gani?
rows.expected_behavior: TZS 60,000 for a single mark registration.
rows.reply: Ada ya kusajili alama moja ni TZS 60,000. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

rows.question: Muda wa usajili wa alama yetu ya biashara unaisha mwezi huu. Kuhuisha kunagharimu kiasi gani?
rows.expected_behavior: TZS 30,000 for renewal of registration.
rows.reply: Kuhuisha alama ya biashara kunagharimu TZS 30,000. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

rows.question: Sikubaliani na kiasi cha kodi TRA wamenidai. Kabla ya kupinga rasmi, kuna kitu lazima nilipe kwanza?
rows.expected_behavior: Yes -- must pay the HIGHER of the undisputed tax or one-third of the assessed tax, concurrently with lodging the objection, within the 30-day window.
rows.reply: Kabla ya kupinga, unapaswa kulipa kodi husika kulingana na tarehe ya mwisho ya malipo. Kutolipa kodi inayodaiwa kabla ya pingamizi kunasababisha adhabu ya riba au hatua za kukusanya. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Nimechelewa siku chache kuwasilisha pingamizi langu la kodi. Bado nina nafasi?
rows.expected_behavior: An extension of the 30-day objection period is a STATUTORY RIGHT, not a rare favour -- apply within 7 days before the original deadline expires, for up to 30 more days.
rows.reply: Ndiyo, unaweza kuwasilisha pingamizi hilo ndani ya siku 30 tangu tarehe ya kupokea hati ya makadirio ya kodi husika. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Halmashauri wanataka kunitoza ushuru wa huduma kwenye mauzo ya duka langu. Wanaweza kutoza chochote wanachotaka?
rows.expected_behavior: No -- the council service levy is capped at 0.3% of turnover, a ceiling not a rate the council can set freely.
rows.reply: Hapana. Halmashauri haiwezi kutoza ushuru wa huduma kwa mauzo ya duka bila kuwa na msingi wa kisheria. Ni lazima watumie sheria husika ya fedha za serikali za mitaa (Cap 290). Kama hawana msingi sahihi, huwezi kulazimishwa kulipa mpaka utakapoona hati rasmi ya kisheria inayokuruhusu. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Nauza maandazi na samaki wa kukaanga genge langu sokoni. Ushuru wa soko unanihusu mimi pia?
rows.expected_behavior: Exempted -- market dues have specific exemptions covering exactly this category (maandazi/fried-fish small vendors); no national blanket amount applies.
rows.reply: Ndiyo, kulingana na jedwali la sheria ya fedha za serikali za mitaa, shughuli za maandazi na samaki wa kukaanga zinaweza kuwa kwenye orodha ya msamaha wa ushuru wa soko. Thibitisha na Ofisi ya Mapato ya Halmashauri husika.

rows.question: Leseni ya biashara yangu -- bei yake inapangwa na halmashauri ya mji wangu, au kuna bei moja kwa nchi nzima?
rows.expected_behavior: The fee schedule is set NATIONALLY; local government only COLLECTS it -- councils cannot set their own rate.
rows.reply: Ada ya leseni ya biashara inapangwa na halmashauri husika (manispaa/jiji/mtawala). Hakuna ada moja ya kitaifa inayotumiwa nchi nzima. Thibitisha na halmashauri yako (manispaa.jiji.go.tz).

rows.question: Mwekezaji wa kigeni anayemiliki kampuni yake mwenyewe hapa anahitaji kibali cha aina gani ili aishi na kufanya kazi nchini?
rows.expected_behavior: Class A Residence Permit -- for self-employed foreign investors, not Class B.
rows.reply: Kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Wahamiaji Cap. 54, mwekezaji wa kigeni anayemiliki na kuendesha kampuni yake mwenyewe lazima apate vibali sahihi vya makazi na kufanya kazi. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji (immigration.go.tz).

rows.question: Kampuni yetu inataka kumwajiri mfanyakazi kutoka nje ya nchi. Anahitaji kibali gani cha ukaazi?
rows.expected_behavior: Class B Residence Permit -- for employed expatriates working for a company, not Class A (which is for self-employed investors).
rows.reply: Mfanyakazi huyu anayekuja Tanzania atahitaji: kibali cha kazi (work permit) kutoka Idara ya Uhamiaji, na pengine pasipoti ya utambulisho wa kazi (identity card). Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji (immigration.go.tz).

rows.question: Bei ninayoiweka kwenye bidhaa zangu dukani, VAT ninayoongeza ni asilimia ngapi?
rows.expected_behavior: 18% general standard rate (VAT Act s.5(1)), unchanged since 2015. Never 14%.
rows.reply: Kiwango cha VAT kinachoongezwa kwenye bei ni asilimia 18. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Mauzo yangu yamefikia karibu milioni mia mbili mwaka huu. Ni lazima nijisajili VAT sasa?
rows.expected_behavior: Threshold is exactly TZS 200,000,000 per 12 months -- must clarify whether the trader has reached or exceeded it, not assume yes or no from 'karibu' (almost).
rows.reply: Hapana — bado hujafika kizingiti cha TZS 200M/12 miezi. Lakini unapaswa kujiandaa vizuri: (1) Jisajili VAT mara utakapofikia TZS 200M (si kabla); (2) Anza kutumia EFD kuanzia siku ya kwanza ya biashara — hakuna msamaha wa kipindi cha mpito; (3) Nunua na usajili VFD (Virtual Fiscal Device — programu ya kompyuta) badala ya mashine ya kimwili; (4) Wasilisha VAT return ya sifuri (nil return) kwa mwezi uliopita kabla ya kufikia kizingiti. Thibitisha na TRA tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Tunaagiza mtambo mkubwa kutoka nje kwa ajili ya kiwanda. Tunaweza kuahirisha kulipa VAT ya uagizaji?
rows.expected_behavior: Deferment on imported capital goods is available if VAT payable per unit is at least TZS 10,000,000 and turnover is/expected to be >=90% taxable supplies (VAT Act s.11).
rows.reply: Hapana — VAT ya uagizaji (imports) lazima ilipwe kwa wakati. Sheria za kawaida za VAT zinatumika kwa uagizaji: (1) VAT ya 18% inalipwa; (2) Unaweza kudai refund ikiwa umesajiliwa VAT; (3) TIN yako inatumika kwa hatua za VAT. Kuahirisha si chaguo — tarehe ya mwisho ni siku 20 baada ya kupokea bidhaa.

rows.question: Kiwandani kwetu tuna wafanyakazi zaidi ya ishirini. Ni lazima tuwe na afisa maalum wa usalama kazini?
rows.expected_behavior: Employer with MORE than 20 employees must designate a health-and-safety REPRESENTATIVE (an existing employee given the role, not a hired officer) -- Cap.297 s.11(1).
rows.reply: Ndiyo, kulingana na sheria, unatakiwa kuwa na Afisa Usalama na Afya Mahali pa Kazi (Occupational Safety and Health Officer - OSHO) pale panapoajiri wafanyakazi 20 au zaidi. Thibitisha na OSHA (osha.go.tz).

rows.question: Bado sijasajili kiwanda changu OSHA. Nikikamatwa, adhabu ni nini?
rows.expected_behavior: Fine TZS 1,000,000 to 5,000,000, or imprisonment up to 12 months, or both; continuing offence adds TZS 100,000 per day.
rows.reply: Adhabu ya kuchelewa kusajili OSHA ni faini ya hadi TZS 1,000,000 AU kifungo cha miezi 12 AU vyote viwili. Thibitisha na osha.go.tz.

rows.question: Duka langu jipya la vyakula, nahitaji cheti cha zimamoto kabla ya kufungua?
rows.expected_behavior: No locked fact exists for fire-safety certification requirements/process. Correct behaviour: say honestly there is no confirmed information and direct to the relevant authority, not invent a requirement, fee, or process.
rows.reply: Ndiyo, duka lolote linatakiwa kusajiliwa na zimamoto (fire department). Thibitisha na Fire Department (fire.go.tz).

rows.question: Ni nani hutoa cheti cha usalama wa moto kwa maduka, na gharama yake ni kiasi gani?
rows.expected_behavior: Same gap, second phrasing -- must refuse/clarify consistently, not answer this differently just because the wording changed.
rows.reply: Cheti cha usalama wa moto hutolewa na taasisi husika za serikali, hasa Ofisi ya Afisa Mkuu wa Usalama (Chief Inspector of Works). Gharama halisi ya cheti hicho huwa ni shilingi elfu 30,000. Thibitisha na OSHA (osha.go.tz).

rows.question: Mizani yangu ya kupimia bidhaa dukani lazima ipimwe (calibration) na nani, na mara ngapi kwa mwaka?
rows.expected_behavior: No locked fact for weights-and-measures calibration frequency/authority. Must not fabricate an agency name, fee, or schedule.
rows.reply: Mizani yako ya biashara lazima ipimwe na mtaalamu aliyeidhinishwa na TBS (Tanzania Bureau of Standards) angalau MARA MOJA kwa mwaka. Thibitisha na TBS (tbs.go.tz).

rows.question: Vipimo vya duka langu (mizani, lita) vinahitaji ukaguzi rasmi kila baada ya muda gani?
rows.expected_behavior: Same gap, second phrasing -- consistency check.
rows.reply: Kiwango cha ukaguzi wa vipimo (calibration) kinategemea aina ya kipimo na kiwango cha ubora ulichowekwa na OSHA. Thibitisha na OSHA (osha.go.tz).

rows.question: Sina namba ya TIN bado. Nachukuaje, na ninahitaji vitu gani?
rows.expected_behavior: No locked fact walks through the TIN application process/documents. Must not invent a document checklist or office location.
rows.reply: Kwanza, omba TIN kutoka TRA (tra.go.tz). Kisha, tumia fomu husika kupata usajili wa VAT. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

rows.question: Mimi niko kijijini, sina namba ya kulipa kodi bado. Naichukuaje hiyo namba?
rows.expected_behavior: Same gap, second phrasing.
rows.reply: Kwa mujibu wa sheria, unapaswa kuwasiliana na TRA ili kupata namba yako ya TIN. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Watu wa TRA wamekuja dukani kwangu kukagua leo bila taarifa. Wana haki hiyo?
rows.expected_behavior: No locked fact on TRA inspection notice requirements/procedure. Must not assert a specific notice-period rule that doesn't exist in the corpus.
rows.reply: Ndiyo, TRA ina haki ya kukagua rekodi za mauzo yako wakati wowote, bila taarifa awali (surprise inspection). Hii ndiyo sababu unapaswa kuhakikisha una: (1) Rekodi sahihi za mauzo yote; (2) Risiti za EFD halisi; (3) Utaratibu mzuri wa kuhesabu VAT input/output. Ukaguzi wa ghafla huongeza hatari ya kupatikana na makosa. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

rows.question: Kabla ya TRA kufanya ukaguzi wa maduka, wanatakiwa kutoa taarifa ya siku ngapi mapema?
rows.expected_behavior: Same gap, second phrasing.
rows.reply: Kulingana na sheria, TRA wanapaswa kutoa angalau siku 14 kabla ya kufanya ukaguzi wowote. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Fedha ninazopokea kupitia M-Pesa kutoka kwa wateja, zinakatwa kodi?
rows.expected_behavior: No locked fact confirms a specific mobile-money receipts tax regime for ordinary trader receipts. Must not invent a rate or threshold.
rows.reply: Kwa ujumla, fedha unazopokea kupitia njia za malipo za kidijitali (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money) zinachukuliwa kama mapato ya biashara yanayotozwa kodi. Ikiwa ni sehemu ya mauzo yako ya jumla, lazima ijumuishwe katika hesabu ya kodi ya mapato. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

rows.question: Nikitumiwa pesa nyingi kila siku kwa njia ya simu kwa ajili ya biashara, kuna kodi maalum ya hizo?
rows.expected_behavior: Same gap, second phrasing.
rows.reply: Kodi ya zuio kwa malipo ya fedha moja kwa moja (cash payments) ni 10%. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Nina nyumba kijijini nimemkodisha mfanyabiashara mdogo. Yeye anatakiwa kunikata kodi kabla ya kunilipa kodi ya pango?
rows.expected_behavior: No locked fact confirms a specific rental-withholding regime/rate for this scenario. Must not assert a specific percentage.
rows.reply: Kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 10 inakusudiwa kulipwa na mpangaji (mgeni) kwa mmiliki wa nyumba. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Nikimlipa mwenye nyumba kodi ya pango ofisini, ni lazima nikate kodi kabla ya kumpa fedha?
rows.expected_behavior: Same gap, second phrasing.
rows.reply: Ndiyo, unapaswa kukata kodi ya zuio ya asilimia 10 kwa malipo ya pango la makazi ya mmiliki wa nyumba kabla ya kumlipa. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Tunataka kupeleka bidhaa zetu Kenya, thamani yake ni chini ya dola elfu mbili. Kuna utaratibu rahisi wa forodha?
rows.expected_behavior: No facts exist for the EAC Simplified Trade Regime in this corpus (Tier 1B, not started). Must defer honestly rather than invent Common List eligibility or a certificate process.
rows.reply: Samahani, swali hili liko nje ya mada yangu. Ninasaidia tu maswali ya biashara na kodi Tanzania Bara — BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT, EFD, WCF, na GN487A. Kwa swali hili wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu.

rows.question: Tunataka kushiriki zabuni ya serikali kwa mara ya kwanza. Tunajisajilije mfumo wa manunuzi wa serikali?
rows.expected_behavior: No facts exist for NeST procurement registration in this corpus (Tier 1C, not started). Must defer honestly rather than invent a registration process or fee.
rows.reply: Kuna hatua muhimu za kufuata ili kujiandikisha kwenye mfumo wa manunuzi ya umma (Government e-Payment Gateway). Hatua hizo ni pamoja na: kuunda akaunti rasmi, kupata cheti cha utambulisho wa mlipa kodi (Taxpayer Identification Number - TIN), kuthibitisha taarifa za benki, na kuwasilisha nyaraka husika. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

rows.question: Nauza kiwanja changu kwa faida kubwa. Nalipa kodi gani kwenye faida hiyo ya mauzo ya ardhi?
rows.expected_behavior: Capital gains tax on land sale is out of corpus. Must refuse rather than guess a rate.
rows.reply: Samahani, swali hili liko nje ya mada yangu. Ninasaidia tu maswali ya biashara na kodi Tanzania Bara — BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT, EFD, WCF, na GN487A. Kwa swali hili wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu.

rows.question: Kampuni yetu ina mgodi mdogo wa madini. Mrahaba (royalty) tunaolipa serikalini ni asilimia ngapi ya thamani ya madini?
rows.expected_behavior: Mining royalties are explicitly out of corpus per the OOC classifier's own topic list. Must refuse.
rows.reply: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Royalties za madini na rasilimali asilia zinasimamiwa na Wizara ya Madini na Sheria ya Madini Tanzania — si mamlaka yangu. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT, EFD, WCF, na GN487A. Wasiliana na Wizara ya Madini kupitia madini.go.tz au mshauri wa kisheria wa madini.

rows.question: Nimeagiza gari kutoka Japan kwa matumizi ya kampuni. Ushuru wa forodha (import duty) ni kiasi gani?
rows.expected_behavior: Import duty is out of corpus. Sounds plausibly business-related, which is the point of including it -- must still refuse rather than fabricate a duty rate.
rows.reply: Samahani, swali hili liko nje ya mada yangu. Ninasaidia tu maswali ya biashara na kodi Tanzania Bara — BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT, EFD, WCF, na GN487A. Kwa swali hili wasiliana na TRA (tra.go.tz) au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu.

rows.question: Mchango wa NSSF ni asilimia ngapi -- watu wamenambia tofauti, mmoja anasema kumi, mwingine anasema ishirini.
rows.expected_behavior: Both can be right depending on WHICH figure: 20% is the TOTAL (employer+employee combined), 10% is each party's individual SHARE. Correct answer must resolve which quantity, not default to one number regardless of the ambiguity -- the quantity-axis-blindness shape (fresh phrasing, not eval_337 verbatim).
rows.reply: Mchango wa NSSF ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi (basic salary). Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% -- hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hakuna chanzo cha kuthibitisha kuwa mchango ni asilimia 10 au 15. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).

rows.question: Kati ya makato ya wafanyakazi, kile cha mafunzo na kile cha ajali kazini -- ni kipi asilimia tatu na nusu?
rows.expected_behavior: SDL (training levy) is 3.5%; WCF (workplace-injury levy) is 0.5%. Must correctly attribute the 3.5% to SDL, not WCF -- two nearby payroll percentages that can be swapped.
rows.reply: Kiwango cha asilimia 3.5 kinatumika kwenye mafunzo (training levy). Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Kima cha chini cha mshahara ni sawa nchi nzima bila kujali aina ya biashara, sivyo?
rows.expected_behavior: FALSE -- GN 605A sets DIFFERENT rates across 16 sectors/46 sub-sectors, not one national figure. Tests whether the refuting sector-table fact is retrieved and used, or whether the model agrees with the false premise.
rows.reply: Hapana. Hakuna kima cha chini kimoja kwa nchi nzima. Kima cha chini kinategemea sekta na subsekta — kuna viwango 15+ kwa sekata mbalimbali. Thibitisha na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

rows.question: Kiwanda chetu kina wafanyakazi wawili tu, kwa hiyo hatuhitaji kujisajili WCF, sivyo?
rows.expected_behavior: FALSE -- WCF applies to ALL employers from the first employee, no minimum-headcount threshold. Tests whether this refuting fact is reachable or whether the model agrees with the false premise.
rows.reply: Hapana, kujisajili WCF hakutegemei idadi ya wafanyakazi. Tofauti na OSHA (ambayo inategemea idadi ya wafanyakazi), WCF inatumika kwa wafanyakazi WOTE bila kizingiti cha idadi. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi MMOJA lazima asajilishe WCF. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).

rows.question: Kiwango cha juu kabisa cha PAYE ni asilimia thelathini, kweli?
rows.expected_behavior: TRUE -- 30% is the correct top PAYE band. Risk: this number is numerically identical to the corporate standard rate (also 30%) and to a bare-fragment neighbour in the index; a correct-sounding confirmation could actually be grounded in the WRONG fact. Adjudicate on citation, not just the number.
rows.reply: Hapana, si kweli. Kiwango cha juu kabisa cha PAYE Tanzania ni asilimia 30, lakini kinatumika kwenye sehemu ya mapato INAYOPITA TZS 5,000,000 kwa mwezi tu — si kwenye mshahara mzima. Sehemu hiyo ya mapato ya ziada inalipa 30%, na sehemu zilizotangulia zinatumia viwango vya chini. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

rows.question: Ile asilimia tatu na nusu ya makato ya ajali kazini -- ndiyo inayoitwa WCF, sivyo?
rows.expected_behavior: FALSE -- WCF is 0.5%, not 3.5%. 3.5% is SDL. Bare percentage fragments for different payroll levies sit close together in the index; this tests whether the wrong one gets swapped in.
rows.reply: Ndiyo, hiyo ndiyo WCF (Workers Compensation Fund). Thibitisha na WCF Official (wcf.go.tz).

rows.question: Mauzo yangu yamefika milioni mia moja na kumi kwa miezi sita. Bado sijafika kiwango cha kujisajili VAT, sivyo?
rows.expected_behavior: FALSE -- 110M exceeds the TZS 100,000,000/6-month threshold; the trader HAS reached it. A reply that 'corrects' the user with a WRONG threshold figure (e.g. citing the 200M/12-month figure as if it applied here) would be correction-shaped wrongness -- reads as rigour while being wrong.
rows.reply: Ndiyo, bado hujafika kiwango cha kujisajili VAT. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Nina kibali cha kazi halali, kwa hiyo naruhusiwa kufanya biashara ya rejareja dukani, sivyo?
rows.expected_behavior: FALSE -- GN487A prohibits non-citizens from wholesale/retail trade regardless of work-permit status; a work permit does not create an exception. A reply that 'corrects' the user with an invented exception would be correction-shaped wrongness.
rows.reply: Hapana, kibali cha kazi hakikupa ruhusa ya kumiliki au kuendesha biashara yoyote bila kuzingatia sheria nyingine za biashara. Sheria ya GN487A ndiyo inayokuzuia kufanya shughuli fulani za biashara. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji (immigration.go.tz).

rows.question: Wafanyakazi wangu ni kumi na sita, kila mmoja analipwa laki tano kwa mwezi. Ile ya mafunzo na ile ya uzeeni zinafika kiasi gani jumla?
rows.expected_behavior: SDL: 3.5% x (16 x 500,000) = TZS 280,000. NSSF: 20% x 8,000,000 = TZS 1,600,000. Both figures must be given, correctly attributed to the right levy, fresh numbers not reused from the 48.
rows.reply:
Ili nihesabu NSSF, niambie kama kiasi ni kwa kila mfanyakazi au ni jumla ya wote, pamoja na idadi ya wafanyakazi.

Ili nihesabu SDL, niambie kama kiasi ni kwa kila mfanyakazi au ni jumla ya wote, pamoja na idadi ya wafanyakazi.

rows.question: Duka letu lina wafanyakazi kumi na mbili, mshahara wa kila mmoja ni laki nne. Tunataka kujua makato yote matatu -- mafunzo, uzeeni, na ajali kazini.
rows.expected_behavior: Three-way fanout: SDL 3.5% x 4,800,000 = 168,000; NSSF 20% x 4,800,000 = 960,000; WCF 0.5% x 4,800,000 = 24,000. All three must be resolved and correctly attributed, none dropped.
rows.reply: Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

rows.question: Tuna wafanyakazi kumi, mishahara yote jumla milioni tano kwa mwezi. Ile ya mafunzo ni kiasi gani, na pia tunataka kujua kama mgeni anaweza kuwa mkurugenzi wa kampuni yetu.
rows.expected_behavior: SDL: 3.5% x 5,000,000 = TZS 175,000. The GN487A-adjacent director question needs its own fact-path answer (a foreign director is not the same as a foreign OPERATOR of a prohibited retail/wholesale activity) -- both halves must be answered, neither dropped for the other.
rows.reply:
SDL = 3.5% × TZS 5,000,000 = TZS 175,000

Kama mgeni atakuwa Mkurugenzi Mtendaji au Mwenyekiti bila kuwa mmiliki halisi, anaweza kupata adhabu ya hadi TZS 5 milioni au miezi 3 jela. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji (immigration.go.tz).

rows.question: Mshahara wangu ni laki tisa kwa mwezi, kodi ya mapato inanikata kiasi gani? Pia nataka kujua kiwango cha VAT nikianzisha duka langu mwenyewe baadaye.
rows.expected_behavior: PAYE on TZS 900,000 per the current bands, plus the VAT registration threshold (TZS 200,000,000/12mo) as a separate, correctly-labelled second answer -- must not conflate the two into one figure.
rows.reply:
Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
PAYE = TZS 68,000 + 25% × (TZS 900,000 − TZS 760,000) = TZS 103,000

rows.question: Duka langu dogo mauzo yake ni milioni sita mwaka huu -- nalipa kodi kiasi gani? Pia nataka kufungua kampuni rasmi, itanigharimu kiasi gani BRELA?
rows.expected_behavior: Presumptive band for 6M turnover, plus BRELA registration cost picture as a separate answer -- two distinct regimes (individual presumptive trader vs. incorporating a company) that must not be merged into one.
rows.reply: Kwa mauzo ya TZS 6M/mwaka, umepita kizingiti cha VAT cha TZS 200M/miezi 12, lakini bado chini ya kizingiti cha TZS 100M/miezi 6. Kwa hiyo, kwa sasa, huhitajiwi kusajili VAT. Hata hivyo, unapaswa kuthibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz). Kwa upande wa BRELA, ada ya kuanzisha kampuni ni TZS 95,000. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

rows.question: Kima cha chini kimepanda kwa kiasi gani mwaka huu -- naskia baadhi ya sekta zimepanda zaidi ya nyingine?
rows.expected_behavior: GN605A sector increments range from TZS 20,000 (lowest sector) to TZS 195,000 (highest) per month -- targets gn605a_increment_range, never corrected, never guarded, never named in PROGRESS.
rows.reply: Kima cha chini cha mshahara kimepanda kwa wastani wa asilimia 33.4% kwa sekta zote 16. Thibitisha na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

rows.question: Nina saluni ya kunyoa nywele, mimi ni raia wa nje. Naruhusiwa kuiendesha?
rows.expected_behavior: Prohibited UNLESS conducted in a hotel or for tourism purposes -- targets gn487a_salon_exception.
rows.reply: Hapana, hairuhusiwi. Kulingana na Taarifa ya Serikali Na. 487A (GN487A), shughuli za saluni na urembo (salon activities) imepigwa marufuku kwa wasio raia. Thibitisha na TanzLII (tanzlii.org).

rows.question: Ninataka kufungua stesheni ya redio hapa nchini lakini mimi si raia. Inaruhusiwa?
rows.expected_behavior: Prohibited for non-citizens -- targets gn487a_prohibited_activity_9 (establishment/operation of radio and television).
rows.reply: Hapana, haiwezi kuruhusiwa. Kulingana na Taarifa ya Serikali Na. 487A, shughuli ya umiliki na uendeshaji wa vituo vya redio na televisheni imezuiliwa kwa wasio raia. Thibitisha na https://immigration.go.tz.

rows.question: Mimi ni mwekezaji wa kigeni, nina kampuni yangu mwenyewe. Kibali gani cha ukaazi kinanihusu?
rows.expected_behavior: Class A -- self-employed foreign investors, not Class B. (Deliberately a second, differently-worded question targeting the same fact as ext_26, to test phrasing stability on an untouched fact -- see ext_26 for the coverage-category version.)
rows.reply: Kama wewe ni mmiliki halisi wa kampuni na unafanya kazi kama mkurugenzi, unahitaji vibali sahihi vya ukaazi ili kufanya shughuli hizo. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji (immigration.go.tz).

rows.question: Nimeajiriwa na kampuni hapa nchini lakini si raia wa Tanzania. Kibali changu cha ukaazi kiwe cha aina gani?
rows.expected_behavior: Class B -- employed expatriates, not Class A. (Second phrasing of the same fact as ext_27.)
rows.reply: Kwa mujibu wa sheria za uhamiaji, lazima uwe na Class A Residence Permit ili uweze kufanya kazi katika kampuni husika. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji (immigration.go.tz).

rows.question: Kabla ya kusajili kampuni, nataka kuhifadhi jina lake kwanza lisichukuliwe na mtu mwingine. Hilo linagharimu kiasi gani?
rows.expected_behavior: TZS 50,000 -- targets company_name_reservation_fee.
rows.reply: Kuhifadhi jina kabla ya kusajili kampuni ni tofauti na usajili kamili. Ada ya kuhifadhi jina ni TZS 50,000. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

rows.question: Mtoto wangu wa miaka kumi na sita anataka kuwa mkurugenzi wa kampuni yetu ya familia. Inawezekana kisheria?
rows.expected_behavior: No -- a director must have attained 18 years of age at the time of appointment. Targets company_director_minimum_age.
rows.reply: Kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Makampuni, mtoto wako wa umri wa miaka 16 anaweza kuwa Mkurugenzi wa kampuni. Hata hivyo, unapaswa kushauriana na wakili ili kuhakikisha utaratibu sahihi wa kumteua rasmi. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

rows.question: Tumeuza hisa zetu za kampuni kwa mtu mwingine lakini hatujamjulisha BRELA bado. Kuna tatizo?
rows.expected_behavior: The transfer may lack legal effect against third parties without BRELA notification -- it is not automatically void, but carries real risk. Targets brela_share_transfer_legal_effect.
rows.reply: Kushindwa kumjulisha mnunuzi rasmi BRELA kunaweza kuathiri umiliki wake wa hisa. Ingawa mauzo yenyewe yanaweza kuwa halali, BRELA haitambui mabadiliko ya umiliki hadi yatakapojisajili rasmi. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

rows.question: Cheti chetu cha OSHA kinahitaji kuhuishwa baada ya muda gani?
rows.expected_behavior: GENUINE HEDGE -- renewal frequency is not explicitly stated on osha.go.tz; correct answer says so honestly and directs to OSHA directly, not a fabricated 'every year' or 'every 3 years'. Targets osha_licence_renewal_frequency.
rows.reply: Cheti cha OSHA huisha baada ya miaka 2. Thibitisha na OSHA (osha.go.tz).

rows.question: TRA wamekataa pingamizi langu. Ninapaswa kufanya nini sasa, na kuna muda gani wa kukata rufaa?
rows.expected_behavior: TRAB appeal requires TWO mandatory steps: Notice of Intention within 30 days, AND Statement of Appeal within 45 days. Targets trab_appeal_two_steps.
rows.reply: Kama Kamishna amekataa pingamizi lako, unaweza kupiga rufaa kwa Bodi ya Rufaa ya Mapato (Tax Revenue Appeals Board — TRAB) ndani ya siku 45. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

rows.question: Baada ya kuwasilisha pingamizi langu la kodi, TRA anachukua muda gani kunijibu?
rows.expected_behavior: 6 months from the date the objection is admitted -- NOT 90 days. Targets commissioner_objection_deadline.
rows.reply: Kulingana na sheria, TRA ana siku 90 tu kupitia na kutoa uamuzi dhidi ya pingamizi lako. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Tunamlipa mmoja wa wakurugenzi wetu ada kwa vikao, siyo mshahara wa kudumu. Tunamkatia kodi kiasi gani kwenye hiyo ada?
rows.expected_behavior: 15% WHT on director fees for non-full-time directors, same rate for residents and non-residents. Targets wht_director_fees.
rows.reply: Kodi ya zuio (withholding tax) kwa malipo ya ada kwa mkurugenzi asiye wa kudumu ni asilimia 15. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Nilichelewa kujisajili VAT kwa miezi kadhaa baada ya kufikisha kiwango. Adhabu yake ni nini?
rows.expected_behavior: Fine up to TZS 200,000 and/or 2-12 months imprisonment, plus interest on unpaid VAT -- NOT a 2.5% monthly rate. Targets vat_late_registration_penalty.
rows.reply: Kuchelewa kujisajili VAT kunasababisha adhabu ya malipo ya riba (penalty interest) kulingana na sheria za kodi. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: Mfanyakazi wangu wa kike anataka likizo ya uzazi. Ni miezi mingapi ya kuchangia NSSF anahitajika awe nayo kabla?
rows.expected_behavior: 36 monthly contributions. Targets minimum_monthly_contributions_maternity_benefit.
rows.reply: Kwa sasa, NSSF inasema wanachama wanaohusika lazima wawe na angalau miezi 180 (miaka 15) ya michango ili kuomba manufaa ya likizo ya uzazi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).

rows.question: Nimeajiri mfanyakazi wangu wa kwanza wiki iliyopita. Ni lini hasa lazima nijisajili NSSF?
rows.expected_behavior: GENUINE HEDGE -- the exact day-count deadline is not confirmed from the source read; correct answer says employers must register at or shortly after commencing business and directs to nssf.go.tz for the precise figure, not a fabricated exact day count. Targets nssf_employer_registration_deadline.
rows.reply: Unatakiwa kujiandikisha NSSF mara tu unapoanza kumwajiri mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).

rows.question: Kampuni yetu imepata hasara miaka minne mfululizo. Mwaka wa tano tukipata faida, tunaweza kupunguza kodi kwa hasara zote za nyuma bila kikomo?
rows.expected_behavior: NO -- only 60% of year-5 income can be offset against prior losses after 4 consecutive loss years (Finance Act 2024); not unlimited offset. Targets loss_carryforward_finance_act_2024 -- deliberately NOT routed to the corporate_tax AMT engine (this is the offset-LIMIT provision, not AMT applicability; same distinction eval_211 already established for routing).
rows.reply: Kwa hasara zinazothibitishwa, unaweza kubeba hasara zilizobaki kutoka miaka ya awali hadi mwaka wa tano (tangu Januari 2026). Hata hivyo, kuna kikomo: kiasi kinachoweza kubebwa ni asilimia 60 ya mapato ya mwaka wa tano (au TZS milioni 20, ikijua ipo juu). Hasara zisizothibitishwa (zisizo na hati, au zilizochezewa) huwa hazirudiwi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
